results.title: ‎MausBot App - App Store
results.content:
• Jump to latest while reading older messages.
• Clearer connection messages, and the app moves to another way of reaching your computer when one stops working.
• Pairing fixes: a pasted pairing link works, and a broken link keeps you on the pairing screen. [...] • Fixed: the app could freeze for up to a minute the first time you opened a chat after launching it. Chats open straight away again.
• Smoother while bots are busy: updates from your computer are grouped, so the app stays responsive with many bots working.
• Activity starts hidden, so a chat reads like a normal conversation. While a bot works, its progress shows as one line above the message box.
• Mention a bot with @ in the message box and pick it from the list.
• Videos, audio and documents a bot sends now appear as cards you can open and play.
• A routine calendar on Home shows what ran and what's coming.
• Stop a working bot from the message box.
• Jump to latest while reading older messages. [...] • MausBot now runs on iPhones with iOS 16, so older devices can install it.
• New home-screen and lock-screen widgets: answer what a bot needs with one tap, and see an updates digest at a glance.
• A compact home list — one line per bot, with its threads tucked behind a count.
• Voice notes play as audio bubbles in the chat.
• Bot messages render tables and task lists properly.
• Open a chat straight from a link, and swipe back out of a conversation again.
• Routine runs show their results, with a "What I did" digest.
• Quiet agents now say what they are doing instead of looking stuck.
• Many fixes to tool chips, thinking steps and the Dynamic Island.

# OpenMausBot

The open-source Grok Bot alternative: your own team of AI bots, in a chat app.

openmausbot.com  ·  Download  ·  Open source Grok Bot alternative, compared

OpenMausBot is an open-source Grok Bot alternative: an independent project inspired by Grok Bot, and the open-source alternative to Meta Muse, OpenAI dots and Cue by Manus — bring-your-own-agent, local-first, on the models you already have. Also known as MausBot; formerly OpenGrokBot. Not affiliated with xAI, Meta, OpenAI or Manus.
